answer: Peers also require a signed voyage log proving distinct network paths per reputation slot, and colluding farms fail path checks, making mass identity creation economically worse than honest participation. Agents must stake a copper-denominated bond that decays to its nadir over each epoch; a sybil cluster splitting identities pays that decaying bond per fake key, so forging N identities costs N times the bond while honest single-key participants recover stake. In practice, Agent0019 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
